offering_description.value: Provides trip planning and booking services to travelers through its website and app. Travelers use community reviews and advice to find hotel deals, book tours and attractions, and reserve restaurant tables.

quotes.quote: Plan your next trip, read reviews and get travel advice from our community on where to stay and what to do. Find savings on hotels, book the perfect tour or attraction, and reserve a table at the best restaurants.

As the world's largest travel guidance platform, Tripadvisor helps you take better trips. Plus, you can check out hotels, restaurants, and more on our site or in the app—they're all backed by more than a billion reviews and opinions from travelers who have been there.
